# Sequence sample

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-Hans.md)

This sample increments an integer sequence and a floating-point sequence in the `samples:sequence` namespace.

```shell
dotnet run --project Zongsoft.Externals.Etcd.Sequence.Samples.csproj
```

Pass an etcd connection string as the first argument to override `server=127.0.0.1;port=2379`.
